verdict.rationale: Galileo's metrics overview documents custom metrics that include code-based and composite code-based metrics for evaluations, so the core capability is first-party. The evidence is overview-level only, with no SDK walkthrough or example of writing a scorer. Release notes add that metrics can be global or project-scoped, and the free plan lists unlimited custom evals. Missing for 10: a code-level how-to or SDK reference showing how to author code-based scorers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations
